segments.title: 第51章 人多力量大
segments.content:
Chapter 51 Many Hands Make Light Work

Zhu Yufei woke up early today and witnessed a wonderful scene at the main gate of the dormitory area.

The lady boss was forced to shout out a price of ten yuan per belt, which amused Zhu Yufei. Then, the sharp-eyed Li Luo spotted him.

"Zhu Yufei! Come over here!"

Li Luo waved at him.

"What is it, Class Monitor?" Zhu Yufei walked over, only to have Li Luo hand him a belt. "I was just about to buy one."

"Buy what?" Li Luo said in a low voice, slapping away the ten yuan in his hand. He then shoved the belt into his arms and pulled the athletic committee member into the truck bed. "I have a mission for you."

"What?" Zhu Yufei was pulled onto the truck with a dazed look on his face. He had gotten a free belt, only to find he'd boarded a pirate ship.

"Watch closely. When a classmate from our class comes over to buy a belt, you help me give them one." Li Luo patted his shoulder and said, "It's free for students from our class."

"Oh, okay." Hearing this, Zhu Yufei's sense of responsibility immediately kicked in. He puffed out his chest, patted it, and assured him, "No problem!"

But in the next second, Zhu Yufei's expression froze, and he said softly, a little embarrassed, "But Class Monitor, I don't fucking know everyone in our class."

"I'm here, what are you afraid of?" Li Luo glanced at him. "I'll remind you."

With that, Zhu Yufei felt relieved. But watching Li Luo and Ying Chanxi busy selling belts while he did nothing but wait for his own classmates to show up, he felt a bit sheepish, so he decided to just help them sell.

A short while later, Zhao Rongjun also arrived. He found Li Luo by the truck bed and asked with a puzzled look, "Why'd you call me over so early in the morning?"

"What else could it be for?" Li Luo pulled him over. "Can't you see we're busy? Help out."

Compared to Zhu Yufei, Li Luo was not as polite with Zhao Rongjun, directly drafting him as free labor.

Because Zhao Rongjun was a day student, he was already wearing the belt his grandfather had given him, so he didn't even need a free one, saving Li Luo a bit of money.

Afterward, Hua Xiuxiu also walked out of the dormitory. She saw Li Luo on the truck bed, and her expression immediately went blank.

But in the next second, Li Luo had already called her name, "Hua Xiuxiu, come here!"

"What are you doing?" Hua Xiuxiu stared at his operation, looking stunned. She couldn't understand how, after one night's sleep, her class monitor had become a belt seller.

"Don't worry about all that. You're our vice class monitor, and I have a crucial mission for you," Li Luo told her with a straight face, then pulled her into the team using the same method.

Later, Yan Zhusheng came out too. Li Luo didn't use any more tricks and simply instructed her, "Belts. Sell them."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng didn't ask why, just nodded and went to sell belts.

After six-thirty was the peak time for students to leave the dorms, and many people came to buy belts.

Three lines became four, and then five, six, seven lines, and the speed increased significantly.

And with the subsequent addition of Zhao Rongjun, Yan Zhusheng, and Hua Xiuxiu, the Yimei clothing store completely lost its competitive edge.

After all, people didn't have to walk any extra steps from the gate, and they could even admire school beauties like Ying Chanxi and Yan Zhusheng. Who would still go to the clothing store?

Only a few girls who didn't want to wait in line would head toward the clothing store.

"Wang Xinyu, over here!" Li Luo recognized another classmate, called her over, and had Yan Zhusheng give her a free belt.

Ying Chanxi glanced at Yan Zhusheng and pressed her lips together, then continued selling belts without a word.

Around six-fifty, very few people were coming out of the dorms anymore.

Li Luo had Hua Xiuxiu and the others go on ahead while he stayed behind to help Lin Xiufeng clean up.

Ying Chanxi wasn't in a hurry to leave either. After watching the other students go, she got into the truck bed, crouched down, and looked at Li Luo, who was counting money. "How did you come up with such a move?"

Li Luo stacked the bundles of cash neatly, glanced at her, and replied, "My brain."

"Of course I know it's your brain." Ying Chanxi rolled her eyes at him. "But most people would probably just go buy from that clothing store, right?"

"This is how people like them make money." Li Luo said with a smile, "For something like military training uniform belts, within this small area and short period of time, their clothing store has a monopoly on exorbitant profits."

"But in reality, the wholesale cost of a belt like this isn't even one yuan."

"With a monopoly, they dare to sell them for twenty, thirty, or even forty."

"In just one day, they might pocket a profit of over ten thousand yuan."

"I'm just seizing an opportunity. It just so happens that my cousin-uncle has the stock, and my uncle can drive a truck. Otherwise, I could only watch them rake in the money."

Ying Chanxi crouched in the truck bed, a thoughtful expression on her face after hearing Li Luo's words, as if she had just seen another side of the world.

She was, after all, just a first-year high school student. Even as a top student who got first place in every subject, when faced with this kind of situation, she was still not as sharp as an old hand like Li Luo.

"You brat, you've got a quick mind." Lin Xiufeng took advantage of the temporary lull in students and stepped into the truck bed. He pressed down on Li Luo's head, ruffled his hair vigorously, and said with a chuckle.

Then he crouched down as well, looked at the cardboard box full of cash neatly stacked by Li Luo, and licked his lips. "Your uncle's monthly salary is only six thousand. You've already earned back half my salary in just one morning."

Li Luo chuckled twice, then asked, "Did Cousin-Uncle say anything?"

"I gave him a heads-up. He said to take as many as I want and just keep a record to settle up when I get back." Lin Xiufeng said happily, "These belts were originally small gifts they gave away with clothes at their physical stores. They usually don't even sell them separately. The wholesale price is just a few dimes each."

The cousin-uncle's clothing company dealt directly with clothing factories, so their cost price was the lowest, much cheaper than what the lady boss of the Yimei clothing store could get from the wholesale market.

So even at ten yuan per belt, selling about three to four hundred in one morning still brought Lin Xiufeng an income of over three thousand yuan.

"Here, take this." Lin Xiufeng pulled five red bills from his pants pocket and stuffed them into Li Luo's arms. "I won't give you any more for now. If you're short on pocket money in the future, just ask me. Don't tell your mom, or she'll nag me."

"Alright, love you, Uncle." Li Luo accepted the five hundred yuan for his hard work without any fuss, stuffing it happily into his pocket. He thought for a moment, then pulled out one bill and offered it to Ying Chanxi. "Do you want it?"

"I just came to help out. Are you being polite with me?" Ying Chanxi shot him an annoyed glare. "Am I short of your one hundred yuan?"

"True." Li Luo knew she wouldn't take it and was just being courteous. He then got up and patted his pants. "Then we'll head to school."

"Go on, go on. I'll clean up here." Lin Xiufeng waved his hand.

"Oh, right." Li Luo and Ying Chanxi jumped down from the truck bed. Before leaving, he turned his head again. "Uncle, are you free these next two afternoons? I need to ask you for a favor."

"Huh? I should be." Lin Xiufeng looked at him, puzzled. "What is it? Go on."

"Help me buy some things."
